summary: Tier 1 Sandbox conversion overhaul tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 8 backend pytest cases pass. All critical UI flows pass: 5-question intake with new objective + Other-sector reveal, dropdown contrast bug fix verified (Q2/Q4 SelectTrigger renders dark ink rgb(26,26,26) on white), serif streaming reveal at /sandbox/generating with serif tape-head (Georgia) + italic tape-sub, redirect to /app?tutorial=1, SandboxTutorial card with 3 step links + open-chat + dismiss buttons, ?prompt= prefill into chat-input textarea (and removed from URL), dismiss persists across reload, /app/contexts/new (Add Company) creates a real seeded context (executive_personal) and switches into it. Tutorial endpoint also works on seeded real (non-sandbox) contexts via seeded_metadata branch.
action_items: Optional: review_request mentions data-testid='newctx-q3-role' but implementation uses card-grid testids 'newctx-role-ned|executive|both' (mirrors sandbox). Functionally equivalent and clicked successfully; consider documenting the actual testid pattern in the spec, or add an outer 'newctx-q3-role' wrapper testid for parity with the request.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/sandbox/contexts/{id}/tutorial double-loads seeded_metadata vs sandbox_metadata via `or` chain — clean abstraction; tutorial works for both context flavours.
resolve_stage_texts safely substitutes {other_sector_name} with .format and falls back to 'diversified' on KeyError — correct.
Sandbox session state is in-memory dict with 90s expiry timer — fine for current scale; flag for rollout when horizontal scaling is enabled (sticky sessions or move to Redis).

/api/sandbox/contexts/seeded creates a context but does NOT update accounts.default_context_id for the caller, unlike _seed_sandbox which does. Not a bug per current spec (caller already has a default), but worth noting if 'first context' semantics ever change.
Both endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection ({_id: 0}).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest covers generate (with objective + other_sector substitution, accept-without-objective, status->ready), tutorial GET (with/without objective), tutorial dismiss persistence, and seeded real-context creation (executive + NED) plus tutorial-on-seeded. Frontend manual playwright verified: dropdown contrast (rgb(26,26,26) dark ink), Submit gating logic on Q5 length and other-sector fields, serif/italic stream tape, /app?tutorial=1 redirect, tutorial card 3-step + open-chat + dismiss + persistence-across-reload, /app/contexts/new flow creates a real ctx and switches into it, and the chat composer (data-testid='chat-input') is prefilled from ?prompt= and the param is stripped from the URL. Note: Q3 role uses card grid testids (sandbox-role-{ned/exec/both} and newctx-role-{ned/exec/both}); there is no single 'sandbox-q3-role' or 'newctx-q3-role' testid wrapper.
